The changes recommended will require all parties to rethink their current roles in EA. Proponents have to choose whether or not they want to subject their project to a panel review from the start or to address public concerns through a consensus building process initiated early in their planning process. The public has to engage in project planning with proponents and monitor the planning and decision-making processes to ensure that their concerns have been addressed. The RA must develop new rules of procedure, as outlined above, and commit in ensuring that the proponent has met their obligation in terms of public involvement or call a panel review. Federal and provincial government have to take their role of ongoing participation and leadership in broader issues of planning for sustainability more seriously at the community, provincial and federal level to provide better sustainability criteria against which to evaluate specific projects and policies.
